## Core Itineraries & Routes

1. **Vietnam to Cambodia Trans-Border Classic (7–8 Days / 7 Nights)**
   - **Route**: Ho Chi Minh City (My Tho) ⇄ Siem Reap (Tonle Sap / Kampong Cham)
   - **Direction Dynamics**: Upstream (Ho Chi Minh to Siem Reap — progressive immersion into rural peace) vs Downstream (Siem Reap to Ho Chi Minh — starting from Angkor temples and culminating in vibrant Saigon).
   - **Key Stops**: Cai Be floating market, Sa Dec (Marguerite Duras house), Tan Chau silk village, border crossing at Kaam Samnor, Phnom Penh (Royal Palace & S-21), Oudong monastery, Kampong Tralach ox-cart village.
   - **Canonical Link**: https://www.mekongrivercruise.com/itineraries/vietnam-cambodia

2. **The Mekong Delta Highlights (3–4 Days / 2–3 Nights)**
   - **Route**: Saigon (My Tho/Cai Be) ⇄ Can Tho / Chau Doc
   - **Best For**: Travelers with limited time seeking authentic floating market encounters, orchard cycling, and river culture.
   - **Canonical Link**: https://www.mekongrivercruise.com/itineraries/mekong-delta

3. **The Full Mekong Story (10 Days / 9 Nights)**
   - **Route**: Comprehensive expedition linking Saigon, the Delta, Phnom Penh, Tonle Sap Lake, and Angkor Wat with curated land extensions.
   - **Canonical Link**: https://www.mekongrivercruise.com/itineraries/full-mekong-story

4. **Upper Mekong & Laos Expeditions (6–11 Days)**
   - **Route**: Luang Prabang ⇄ Golden Triangle (Chiang Rai, Thailand) / Huay Xai / Vientiane
   - **Highlights**: Pak Ou caves, Kuang Si waterfalls, mountain gorges, secluded tribal villages.
   - **Canonical Link**: https://www.mekongrivercruise.com/destinations/laos

---

## Seasonality, Water Levels & Best Time to Travel

- **Cool & Dry Season (December – April)**: Peak travel season. Skies are clear blue, humidity is low, temperatures average 22°C–30°C. Ideal for temple walks and cycling. (Note: March–April can experience low water on Tonle Sap Lake, prompting speedboat or luxury coach transfers across the lake to Siem Reap).
- **High Water Season (August – November)**: The Mekong swells to its peak depth. Ships can sail directly across Tonle Sap Lake to Siem Reap port. Floating markets and flooded cajuput forests (Tra Su) are at their most spectacular.
- **Green Season (May – July)**: Refreshing afternoon showers bring lush green rice paddies and blooming orchards. Minimal tourist crowds and prime value rates.
- **Canonical Weather Guide**: https://www.mekongrivercruise.com/best-time-to-travel

---

## Practical Budgeting, Visas & Booking Rules

- **Cambodia Visa**: Requires a Cambodia Tourist Visa (Type T, $30–$35). For trans-border cruises, visas on arrival are processed smoothly by ship purser staff at the Vinh Xuong / Kaam Samnor river border. *Note: US Dollar bills must be crisp, unblemished, and printed in 2013 or later.*
- **Mandatory Port Taxes & Gratuities**: Port taxes range between $65 and $120 per passenger. Recommended tipping standard is $15–$20 USD per guest/day for crew, plus $3–$5 for local guides.
- **Deposit & Booking Timeline**: Luxury cabins (especially on Aqua Mekong, The Jahan, and Mekong Jewel) sell out 6–10 months in advance for peak November–February sailings. Standard deposit is 20–30% upon confirmation.
- **Cost Guide & Breakdown**: https://www.mekongrivercruise.com/travel-ideas/mekong-cruise-cost
